turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who gave Owen a zero before anyone spoke to me?
Hey! Glad you made it, parking here is a nightmare.
I didn't come to talk about parking, Hale.
Love the coat, by the way.
Thank you. Now what do you have besides that checker?
Okay so, I'm thinking we keep this super chill. You seem like a super chill person.
Chill. My son got a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Show me what you have.
